fields.name: personId
fields.description: Owner of this query — the user who ran it.

fields.name: queryText
fields.description: The search text the user typed.
fields.synonyms: query, search term, keywords, search string

fields.name: typeFilter
fields.description: Record-type filter applied to the query; blank = all types.
fields.synonyms: type, kind, category filter, record type

fields.name: scopeJson
fields.description: Serialized scope filters (client/person/date/type) passed through to modules uninterpreted.
fields.synonyms: filters, scope, search filters, filter json

fields.name: pendingModules
fields.description: Scratch: configured module keys still awaiting a fan-out request.

fields.name: requestedCount
fields.description: How many module requests have been emitted for the current query.

fields.name: respondedCount
fields.description: How many modules have answered the current query.

fields.name: fanOutDone
fields.description: Scratch: true once every configured module has been sent its request.

fields.name: searching
fields.description: True while a query is in flight.

fields.name: results
fields.description: Merged answers, one entry per responding module, grouped by moduleKey.

fields.name: resultsSummary
fields.description: Display rendering of the grouped results: one "moduleKey: resultsJson" line per answering module.

fields.name: savedQueryId
fields.description: Id of the persisted SearchQuery row for the current query; blank until saved.

fields.name: lastError
fields.description: Scratch: last failure shown to the user; blank = none.

events.name: SEARCH
events.description: The query as submitted — re-broadcast so downstream listeners (recent-searches trays, analytics) can react without intercepting the input

events.name: MODULE_SEARCH_REQUESTED
events.description: One per configured module key — the module owning that key runs its own search and answers with SEARCH_RESULTS

events.name: GLOBAL_SEARCH_COMPLETED
events.description: Every requested module has answered; the grouped view is final

events.name: QUERY_SAVED
events.description: The query persisted to search history

events.name: QUERY_SAVE_FAILED
events.description: Persisting the query failed — the search itself is unaffected

events.name: FAN_OUT_STEP
events.description: Internal sentinel draining the module queue, one MODULE_SEARCH_REQUESTED per pass; `remaining` is the queue length after the last seed/drop

overridableConfigKeys.label: Modules to search
overridableConfigKeys.description: Comma-separated module keys to fan each query out to (e.g. "contacts,projects,invoices"). Each key gets one scoped MODULE_SEARCH_REQUESTED; the module owning a key subscribes to it and answers with SEARCH_RESULTS. Empty = no fan-out (the query is still persisted to history).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search modules, search scope, sources, providers, search providers, indexes, search targets, modules

overridableConfigKeys.label: Search placeholder
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hint text in the search input.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Keep recent searches
overridableConfigKeys.description: Persist each query as a SearchQuery row so recent and saved searches survive reloads.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search history, recent searches, saved searches, remember searches, keep history
